programme.title: Truck U
programme.desc: Matt and Bruno work on a truck that belongs to a tournament fisherman who uses his truck for work and play. It racks up a lot of miles. They are going to hook this boat captain up with some new products that will make his life a lot easier on the road!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: We’re moving full steam ahead with the Interior of the Heavy Metal cab coming together and now’s the time to get the dash set up. We’ve got new gauges, old gauges and a bunch of empty holes where switches and knobs lived in this truck’s former life. Stacey lays out the dos and donts of getting your dash updated and a layout that makes sense before it gets installed. GearZ hits the road with a special delivery for the Hot Rod Institute for all they’ve done for us and the restoration industry. Feeling a little down about your project? Well, Stacey has a tool tech that’s sure to lift you up! All this and more on GearZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The SR-71 Rapid Tool Express returns as Stacey digs into his old ’59 ford panel truck and shows how to convert it into a one-off tool delivery truck to show off a variety of Cornwell tools. From special shelves, lighting and floor, there are even a few surprises that are tucked away inside this rolling tool cart! Moving to the cab of the vehicle, Stacey addresses some of the issues people have when setting up seats and steering, and shows some simple tricks that make a huge difference in getting your seats and steering dialed in. Then it’s on the rear to lay out the gas tank, and then finally the SR-71 gets a new beak.... from a ’59 T-bird! ...What?!?.... how is that possible? Well, ya gotta watch GEARZ to find out!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The Jeep may be the single most modified vehicle out there. From winches to lights, doors and fenders, if you’ve got a Jeep, it probably has some accessories on it. But despite all that, one of the best things about a Jeep is the removable top. It also sparks one of the biggest debates... What is best: a soft top or a hard top? Stacey takes on the challenge by comparing a factory hard top with the new Bestop Trektop. The test will include everything from ease of install to styling, overall sound decibels and of course, how watertight it is. Hopefully you won’t get wet on this ride! Then it’s back to the shop where Stacey shows you that rotisseries aren’t just for chickens, and how an automotive rotisserie can make life in the shop a lot easier. Finally, it’s on to the right and wrong way to use weatherstrip adhesive to hold your rubbers on. Sound risqué? It’s not... it’s just GEARZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: It’s all about square body GM trucks, because The Stunt Double is back in the shop. First, we take a look back at the this awesome ‘86 Chevy 4x4 Silverado long bed build that pays tribute to the legendary Fall Guy TV truck. From its beginnings as a well-worn farm truck, you’ll see it get an upgraded suspension, interior, drivetrain, as we make it better than I was before... better... stronger... faster... wait, that was a DIFFERENT Lee Majors TV show! After that, we walk you through the paint job and show how it is similar to the Fall Guy truck, only different.... because It’s the Stunt Double!!! No hocus pocus... no movie magic... just a tough truck being built to handle the toughest stunts... only on GEARZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The SR-71 Rapid Tool Express is back on the block and going back together for the last time. Stacey finishes up the frame into a rolling masterpiece with the suspension and drivetrain assembled for the last time. Then the body goes back on, and the interior starts to go together. We’re talking fitting the carpet, steering column and the new dash bezel and stuffing that bezel with custom SR-71 gauges. After that, Stacey shows some tricks on how to choose the right transmission and why rechargeable power tools are giving the tried and true air tools a run for their money! It's all here and more on GearZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: With the e85 market and flex fuel vehicles growing every day, Stacey dives into the myths and truths that surround ethanol and whether or not it’s a good choice for your vehicle. With a little help from Advanced Fuel Dynamics, Stacey installs a new fuel delivery system on a 2017 Mustang to show just how easy it is to up your performance and keep your engine safe at the same time. After that, Stacey and the crew head out west to tell the story of Bestop and how they’ve been making removable Jeep tops for decades. From rock-crawlers to the mall crawlers, Bestops unique past allows us to see what the future of the Jeep world will be. Finally, if you’re trying to decide between a stick or automatic transmission… hang out for a while as Stacey talks about converting your boring automatic to a lively manual transmission. We’ve got all this and more on GearZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: It’s rare for people to reach the age of 100. It’s ever rarer for a business, but that just what Cornwell Quality Tools has done! Take a trip through the last century as Stacey tracks the development of a tool company started by a blacksmith, to the tool truck empire that stresses quality over everything else. Speaking of 100 years…trucks have been around for over a century, and for over a century, truck owners have struggled to find the best way to lift their trucks. Stacey sheds some light on picking the right kind of lift for the truck you’re driving. We’ve got all of this and more on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: There’s nothing like a good mystery. One of our favorite GearZ mysteries is the whereabouts of Copperhead, the legendary C10 that Stacey built more than a decade ago. It seemed like the truck just disappeared. Well, it’s back! And Stacey was reunited with it at the C10 Nationals in Ft. Worth, TX. Tag along as Stacey gets a chance to get behind the wheel again and boil some tires. Back in the garage, Stacey tackles a fuel injection install on a Jeep Scrambler, then checks out the new Core Doors from Bestop. There’s a lot going on and plenty of smoke on the Texas Motor Speedway on this episode of GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: SR-71 Fins, Logo and Mystery Paint
programme.desc: As the SR71 Rapid Tool Express nears completion there are a couple of major things left on the plate before we can fire her up and get her down the road. First, every aircraft must have fins, and Stacey finally finds the fins he’s been looking for since the beginning of this build. Second, a cool logo design shows up at the shop. Third, what’s a stealthy tribute vehicle without stealthy paint? Believe it or not, Stacey’s got some paint that should keep the SR71 flying under the radar. Also, a slightly modified March Performance system will help Stacey get that much closer to putting some spark to this awesome build and stick around for plenty of other tech advice from America’s Gearhead… on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: We’re on the road, again, as Stacey visits a truck enthusiast working on his first ground up restoration. It’s a sweet, clean, square body that’s in good enough condition that it might be on the road in a couple of months. But every build can use a little push, and GearZ On the Road does just that! After that, we dig into toolboxes. Hang out as Stacey talks with two engineers about what makes the new Cornwell Platinum boxes so tough. From rollers to welds, these might be the Ultimate box! Then the Cheetah is back in the garage, but only for a day or two before it heads out to get the body work finished and get some new color. It’s all here on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: STACEY DIGS INTO A PROJECT THAT SHOWS YOU JUST HOW MUCH FUN YOU CAN HAVE FOR ALMOST NO MONEY. BECAUSE HE’S TAKING A DERELECT 70’S ATV, STUFFING IN A JUNKYARD ENGINE, TOSSING IN SOME GOOD OL’ AMERICAN INGENINUITY AND ENDING UP WITH A REALLY COOL RIG. IT’S CHEAP! IT’S FUN! AND YOU’LL BE SURPRISED WHAT YOU LEARN ON A PROJECT LIKE THIS!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: What do you get when you cross the quentessential girl's car, the Mazda Miata, with the ultimate guy's car...the Shelby Cobra? Well, Gearz is the only place to find out as Stacey blows apart an innocent Miata to get it ready for its conversion into a V8 powered, screamin' machine called the "Banshee."

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Last week he made room, this week the transplant takes place as Stacey stuffs a 400 horsepower V8 into a Mazda Miata. If you've ever wondered if it's possible to actually build a blindingly fast car on a reasonable budget...The Banshee is the project you need to see. And Gearz is the olny place to see it.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz

programme.title: Around the ACL
programme.desc: ATA 198: Signature #1 Recap, Richards Takes Singles, and New Champions Emerge This week on Around the ACL, Meesh, Trey, and Jake break down all the action from Signature #1, where the 2026 season officially kicked off in a big way. We start with a recap of Pro Doubles, highlighting Ryan Wiedenfeld & Chris Roybal’s standout run, before diving into Singles where Mark Richards once again proved why he’s the standard everyone is chasing. We also cover championship performances across Women’s, Seniors, and Juniors — including Kamryn Belvin, Matt Guy, and Gabriel Clauson — and wrap things up with a look at the next generation of talent in the High School and College divisions. From future stars to seasoned champions, Signature #1 gave us our first clear look at what this season could become.

programme.title: Baselines
programme.desc: Set in Los Angeles, this series follows Jamiel Chambers, a blue chip high-schooler on the brink of escaping the desperate poverty that has berated inner city America. After his junior year ends with him leading his team to a second place finish in the state's regional tournament, Jamiel is hand-picked to play in the city's annual summer league All-Star game. With college recruits swarming and pro agents hedging, the media circus leans in, peddling the question mark around his future like rabid bookies. It is this exposure that gets the attention of Nick Collins, a derelict from a disreputable family from neighboring Irvine. After his doomed-from-the-start plan to capitalize on Jamiel's notoriety ends in with fatal results, family members from both sides are pulled into a series of events which will not only effect Jamiel's trajectory, but will set up one of the most intense family feuds the city has ever witnessed.

programme.title: Ben Fogle: Starting Up Starting Over
programme.sub-title: Ben Fogle: Starting Up Starting Over S01 E01
programme.desc: In 2016, newlyweds Jade and Alice (aged 34 and 26 at the time) decide to turn their backs on successful careers in London to relocate 500 miles north to the stunning Scottish Highlands. They plough the proceeds from selling their flat in Croydon and all their savings into buying and restoring a 200 year old rundown and remote small hotel, in order to start new lives being their own boss as hoteliers and restaurateurs.

programme.title: Ben Fogle: Starting Up Starting Over
programme.sub-title: Ben Fogle - Starting Up Starting Over S02 E04
programme.desc: Ben Fogle spends a year following John (68), Heather (66) and their grown up children as they make a brand new life as cheese producers on a 240 acre farm in Derbyshire, after successful careers as vets living in busy Ripley.

programme.title: Travel Man
programme.sub-title: Travel Man S06 E01 - Brussels With Lee Mack
programme.desc: Richard Ayoade returns to provide much needed guidance and inspiration to would-be mini-breakers. This time, Richard is joined by comedian Lee Mack for a funny, yet surprisingly informative, 48 hours in Brussels - featuring culture, comics, pralines, puppets and attractions both large and small, including the Grand Place and the famous atom-shaped Atomium. There's also waffles, mussels - including Moules Genghis Khan - and the secrets of chocolate making.

programme.title: Travel Man
programme.sub-title: Travel Man S06 E02 - Oslo With Fay Ripley
programme.desc: Richard is joined by actor Fay Ripley for a wintry mini-break in Oslo. Together they pack two days with sledging, screaming, skiing, sculpture and scoff.

programme.title: Travel Man
programme.sub-title: Travel Man S06 E03 - Madeira With Robert Webb
programme.desc: Richard Ayoade is joined by comic actor and writer Robert Webb - the destination Madeira. Together they seek to discover more than the Portuguese island's eponymous wine and cake, although both are sampled along the way. Madeira is famed for its bananas and for the culinary bravado of combining them with fish.

programme.title: Travel Man
programme.sub-title: Travel Man S06 E04 - Cote DAzur With Shazia Mirza
programme.desc: Richard Ayoade is joined by comedian Shazia Mirza for a fancy two day detour on the Côte d'Azur, in the south of France. In Nice they hire a three-wheeled 'Nice Car' for a scenic tour of the city. They also scope out Cap Ferrat, blue art, fancy yachts, and a grotto in Monaco. Later, there's a pricey helicopter ride and a trip to the casino - in a bid to win back the budget overspend on the helicopter.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.sub-title: Health Explored S01 E07 - The pursuit of Happiness Pt 2
programme.desc: In the emotionally charged episode host Mike honors a deeply personal commitment to his late father, who passed away from cancer, to seek out the true meaning of happiness. Following this heartfelt promise, we venture to Bhutan, a remarkable country where happiness is not merely an emotion, but a national policy ingrained in its culture. From the lively capital of Thimphu to the peaceful farmlands of Punakha, we explore how Bhutan has seamlessly woven well-being into all aspects of life—from its education system that teaches happiness as a subject to its communities that prioritize collective well-being. This journey serves as both a tribute to Mike's father and an investigation into how Bhutan's unique approach to happiness could offer transformative insights for our own lives. Join us on this poignant and enlightening trip to the Land of the Thunder Dragon as we delve into what happiness truly means, fulfilling a promise and enriching our understanding of life's greatest pursuit.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.sub-title: Health Explored S01 E08 - The Purpose of life Pt 1
programme.desc: Have you ever hiked with all five senses? Join us on a journey from the bustling metropolis of Tokyo to the serene Okutama forest to meet Dr. Kagawa, the pioneering scientist who first validated the health benefits of nature immersion. Together, we engage in Shinrin Yoku, commonly known as forest bathing, a sensory-rich experience that invites us to use all five senses as we explore the wooded landscape. This episode reveals that forest bathing is far more than just a nature hike; it's a practice of mindfulness that fully immerses us in the present moment through sight, sound, smell, touch, and taste. Learn how this deeply rooted Japanese tradition offers both physical and psychological benefits, opening your mind and tuning your senses to the therapeutic powers of nature. Join us on this eye-opening expedition and discover how you, too, can improve your well-being through the simple yet transformative act of forest bathing.

programme.title: Going Beyond
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: The 77: A City of Neighborhoods
programme.desc: The energy is palpable in Humboldt Park, home to a thriving Puerto Rican community. The centerpiece of the neighborhood is the Paseo Boricua, a colorful cultural corridor that proudly showcases the history, culture, and cuisines of Puerto Rico. Join us as we meet a few of the area’s inspiring residents and multi-generational businesses.

programme.sub-title: Road Trip Masters: Adams County, PA
programme.desc: Nick and Brian road trip to apple country where they meet the Apple Queen and some real thirsty farmers. They find a tranquil B&B just outside of Gettysburg then visit a tavern built in 1776. They wind up in a wild west gunfight heading out of town.

programme.title: V Is For Vino
programme.desc: Languedoc-Roussillon is France's largest wine region and has more organic vineyard land than anywhere else on the planet! Its sheer size means it can produce an enormous variety of wine styles, from sparkling wines to rich whites, spicy reds, and even luscious dessert wines. Biodynamic winemaking pioneer Gérard Bertrand takes center stage, highlighting why caring for the planet and producing incredible wines aren't mutually exclusive.

programme.title: V Is For Vino
programme.desc: Lebanon is remarkable! It's one of the world’s oldest wine regions, full of resilient people, ancient winegrowing heritage, and fresh cuisine that rivals any gastronomy on the planet! Besides having a robust winegrowing history, the country’s Mediterranean climate and mountainous terrain produce a host of delicious, fresh wines, from crisp indigenous white grapes like Obeidy and Merwah to rich, spicy blends of Cabernet and Syrah. Plus, the food is some of the most flavorful in the world, and the people have a zest for life.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 24: Enfrentamientos y Confesiones Inesperadas o Gabriel, Ignacio y la Tension Creciente o La Verdad de Alfonso e Isadora
programme.desc: Gabriel se asusta muchísimo cuando casi atropella a un chico en la calle mientras iba contemplando la fotografía de Marisela y el muchacho que no es otro que Ricardo niega que le haya hecho algún daño. Bertica trata de reconocer en la mujer tan distinta que tiene enfrente a su Abril de años atrás y se desmaya debido a la emoción que siente. Alfonso cuando ve a Ignacio trata de demostrar alegría, pero Ignacio está furioso y se le enfrenta de inmediato intentando conocer la relación que el hombre mantiene con su nuera. Ricardo molesto se aleja de Gabriel mientras que éste se queda pensando si se tratará del amigo de Gabriela, pero desecha la idea considerando que no es posible. Ignacio presiona a Alfonso para que le confiese si es cierto que se está acostando con Isadora.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 67: Dileidi y Luis Fernando se reencuentran
programme.desc: Dileidi se encuentra en la playa extrañando a su novio Luís Fernando y a su vez, Luís Fernando está en la playa pero en el club también extrañando a su Dileidi y sin saber los dos que están en la misma playa. Santiago llega al lugar en donde está Luís Fernando y lo convida al verlo como está a que se relaje y de un paseo, cosa que Luís Fernando acepta hacer. Dileidi y Luís Fernando se encuentran en la playa y se asombran mucho por su encuentro y se confiesan que cada uno estaba pensando en el otro. Luís Fernando en la conversación le pide explicaciones de por qué termino con el, y lo mucho que la quiere. Monchito y Pascuita discuten porque ella quiere ir a comprar unos muebles y el necesita terminar un trabajo que está haciendo con Matilde, mientras que allí presente está Alegría chateando con Ernesto y le comenta que sus padres se están peleando. Ernesto también le cuenta que su mamá Matilde y Gonzalo también se pelean porque Matilde tiene que trabajar con Monchito y Gonzalo no quiere. Egle, Cristinita, Felicita, Tatianita y la Nena están asoleándose en la orilla de la piscina. Tatianita y Felicita se enteran por medio de Santiago que Luís Fernando fue a pasear por la playa y ellas deciden ir a buscarlo. Luís Fernando y Dileidi siguen conversando, y el todavía no entiende porque ella no quiere nada con el, Dileidi le pide que la acompañe para que conozca a su madre y a su familia y así entenderá el porqué termino con el. Cuando se disponen a ir llega Felicita y Alegría en busca de Luís Fernando. Dileidi se molesta mucho, le reclama a Luís Fernando por las catiritas y se va del lugar. Cuando Dileidi llega al sitio en donde se encuentra su familia, Gladis le pide explicación por la cara que tiene, Dileidi la esquiva y se van caminando al sitio en donde esta Gabito, cuando están allí llega Doroteo con unos pescado y añora la presencia de la nena y lo mucho que ella supuestamente disfrutaría allí con ellos. Cosa que Gabito duda mucho. La Nena que está dentro de la piscina con Egle le comenta sobre Doroteo y que lo tiene que olvidar, pero Egle se rie y le dice que así no cree porque ella lo ha nombrado todo el tiempo. En eso llega Luís Fernando muy enojado y Egle trata de hablar con el, pero está muy furioso. Cuando Luís Fernando está en un lugar de la piscina apartado aprovecha Felicita y se le acerca y comienza a hablar con el sobre los momentos que vivieron juntos, y le ofrece su apoyo y hace que Luís Fernando dude sobre Dileidi. Por otro lado Aureliano aprovecha y aborda a Dileidi y conversa con ella sobre la cara que tiene y además le comenta sobre lo bien que la podría pasar con el si no estuviera empeñada en Luís Fernando. Dileidi duda también de Luís Fernando así como hizo el. La Nena se fue a la playa y reflexiona sobre la forma en que se tiene que sacar de la mente a Doroteo, pero decide y se mete al agua y para su sorpresa cuando sale se encuentra con su Doroteo. Ella comienza a discutir con el y comienza a ahogarse, Doroteo la salva y la saca del agua. Ya fuera del agua Doroteo junto a sus amigos, le da respiración boca a boca a la Nena convirtiéndose en un beso. La Nena abre los ojos y lo ve, y se levanta, Doroteo le dice que ella es de el por haberle salvado la vida y la Nena le da una cacheta y se va de allí. Doroteo se queda muy contento por salvarle la vida a su amada. Pascuita va a que la persona que la depila le inyecte en la cara unas vitaminas, Alegría trata de persuadirla pero ella no escucha consejo. Ya Matilde y Monchito están reunidos para lo del trabajo que tienen que sacar pero los dos no se pueden concentrar en el trabajo por lo enamorado que están y hablan sobre lo que sienten. Gonzalo que se quedo con los morochos, los lleva a donde Rosita para que se los cuide porque el sale con José Tadeo. Después que Felicita hablo con Luís Fernando, Tatiana aprovecha que está solo y se le acerca, le dice lo mucho que el le gusta y le da todo su apoyo. Luís Fernando después de todo eso decide ir a buscar a Dileidi. Yuraima y Yeniluz se dan cuenta y van a avisarle a Dileidi, a su vez cuando Dileidi se entera se esconde para que el no la encuentre. Luís Fernando en su búsqueda se encuentra con Jerson y se da cuenta que el fue quién lo quiso robar pero Luís Fernando lo le para y le cuenta que está buscando a la mujer que ama. Gabito que está con Gladis conversando le reitera su amor, pero Gladis le sigue rechazando. Egle le comenta a la Nena sobre lo aburrida que estaba ella en su matrimonio con Rómulo. Por otro lado Rómulo se dispone a ver su televisión y Betzaida llega a la casa y le recuerda que tienen que salir para los preparativos de la boda, Rómulo trata de salirse del compromiso y no lo logra, pero lo que Rómulo quiere en realidad es quedarse en casa como lo hacía con Egle. Por otro lado Egle se va a pasear por el club y es abordada por Santiago, este comienza a conversar con ella y le insinúa lo bella y divertida que es, y que si estaría dispuesta a salir con un muchacho como el, pero Egle se da cuenta y le pregunta a Santiago si la está invitando a salir.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 12: La Muerte de Reinaldo y Sospechas.
programme.desc: Daniela le dice a su padre que Luis Guillermo es su invitado. Armando no sale de su asombro y Daniela le dice que él está al tanto de los sucedido el día de la boda. Diego piensa en lo que está haciendo al vivir con una mujer que no ama. Marisela sueña despierta en que Diego se ha convertido en su príncipe anhelado. Daniela y Luis tratan de convencer a Armando que su visita es para estrechar los lazos familiares únicamente. Asunta intuye la muerte de Reinaldo. Armando le pregunta a Luis sobre la salud de Reinaldo. Inés recibe la noticia sobre la muerte de Reinaldo en Miami. Inés llama a Luis para darle la noticia. Inés va a casa de Diego a darle la noticia y Michelle le hace un desplante recordándole que es una sirvienta.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Ángel, Rogelio, África y más policías allanan la casa de Elda pero no encuentran absolutamente nada. Por otro lado Inmaculada se encuentra en medio de la entrevista que hizo para que las muchachas se hagan los análisis de sangre para ver si logra encontrar a su hija. El espía que mando Simón para que vigilara a Iris saca unas fotos a ella saliendo de la unidad de homicidios. Más tarde se las entrega a Simón y este no lo puede creer. La Viuda Negra tiene atrapada a Vanessa pero no le hace nada. Cuando Vanessa reacciona le hace muchas preguntas pensando que la iba a matar pero no lo hace. Luego la Viuda Negra se saca la careta y le muestra su identidad a Vanessa, la cual no lo puede creer y le promete que no la va a delatar.

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 24: Pacto de silencio y confesion.
programme.desc: Salvador reacciona después de su confesión de amor y saca a Socorro de su habitación. Ella, que todavía sigue en shock, le pide a gritos que necesita hablar con él. Salvador finalmente le hace caso, pero terminan peleándose y reprochándose sus mutuos actos. Ella sale del lugar. Salvador la sigue y le dice que la verdad es que él está con Mercedes únicamente por dinero. Josefina, Isabel y Julio César hacen un pacto de silencio para no decirle jamás a Socorro sobre el verdadero padre del bebé y por ende la relación que tienen Isabel y Julio César.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 24: Enfrentamientos y Confesiones Inesperadas o Gabriel, Ignacio y la Tension Creciente o La Verdad de Alfonso e Isadora
programme.desc: Gabriel se asusta muchísimo cuando casi atropella a un chico en la calle mientras iba contemplando la fotografía de Marisela y el muchacho que no es otro que Ricardo niega que le haya hecho algún daño. Bertica trata de reconocer en la mujer tan distinta que tiene enfrente a su Abril de años atrás y se desmaya debido a la emoción que siente. Ignacio presiona a Alfonso para que le confiese si es cierto que se está acostando con Isadora.

Salvador finalmente le hace caso, pero terminan peleándose y reprochándose sus mutuos actos. Ella sale del lugar. Salvador la sigue y le dice que la verdad es que él está con Mercedes únicamente por dinero. Josefina, Isabel y Julio César hacen un pacto de silencio para no decirle jamás a Socorro sobre el verdadero padre del bebé y por ende la relación que tienen Isabel y Julio César.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 24: Enfrentamientos y Confesiones Inesperadas o Gabriel, Ignacio y la Tension Creciente o La Verdad de Alfonso e Isadora
programme.desc: Gabriel se asusta muchísimo cuando casi atropella a un chico en la calle mientras iba contemplando la fotografía de Marisela y el muchacho que no es otro que Ricardo niega que le haya hecho algún daño. Bertica trata de reconocer en la mujer tan distinta que tiene enfrente a su Abril de años atrás y se desmaya debido a la emoción que siente. Alfonso cuando ve a Ignacio trata de demostrar alegría, pero Ignacio está furioso y se le enfrenta de inmediato intentando conocer la relación que el hombre mantiene con su nuera. Ricardo molesto se aleja de Gabriel mientras que éste se queda pensando si se tratará del amigo de Gabriela, pero desecha la idea considerando que no es posible. Ignacio presiona a Alfonso para que le confiese si es cierto que se está acostando con Isadora.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 67: Dileidi y Luis Fernando se reencuentran
programme.desc: Dileidi se encuentra en la playa extrañando a su novio Luís Fernando y a su vez, Luís Fernando está en la playa pero en el club también extrañando a su Dileidi y sin saber los dos que están en la misma playa. Santiago llega al lugar en donde está Luís Fernando y lo convida al verlo como está a que se relaje y de un paseo, cosa que Luís Fernando acepta hacer. Dileidi y Luís Fernando se encuentran en la playa y se asombran mucho por su encuentro y se confiesan que cada uno estaba pensando en el otro. Luís Fernando en la conversación le pide explicaciones de por qué termino con el, y lo mucho que la quiere. Monchito y Pascuita discuten porque ella quiere ir a comprar unos muebles y el necesita terminar un trabajo que está haciendo con Matilde, mientras que allí presente está Alegría chateando con Ernesto y le comenta que sus padres se están peleando. Ernesto también le cuenta que su mamá Matilde y Gonzalo también se pelean porque Matilde tiene que trabajar con Monchito y Gonzalo no quiere. Egle, Cristinita, Felicita, Tatianita y la Nena están asoleándose en la orilla de la piscina. Tatianita y Felicita se enteran por medio de Santiago que Luís Fernando fue a pasear por la playa y ellas deciden ir a buscarlo. Luís Fernando y Dileidi siguen conversando, y el todavía no entiende porque ella no quiere nada con el, Dileidi le pide que la acompañe para que conozca a su madre y a su familia y así entenderá el porqué termino con el. Cuando se disponen a ir llega Felicita y Alegría en busca de Luís Fernando. Dileidi se molesta mucho, le reclama a Luís Fernando por las catiritas y se va del lugar. Cuando Dileidi llega al sitio en donde se encuentra su familia, Gladis le pide explicación por la cara que tiene, Dileidi la esquiva y se van caminando al sitio en donde esta Gabito, cuando están allí llega Doroteo con unos pescado y añora la presencia de la nena y lo mucho que ella supuestamente disfrutaría allí con ellos. Cosa que Gabito duda mucho. La Nena que está dentro de la piscina con Egle le comenta sobre Doroteo y que lo tiene que olvidar, pero Egle se rie y le dice que así no cree porque ella lo ha nombrado todo el tiempo. En eso llega Luís Fernando muy enojado y Egle trata de hablar con el, pero está muy furioso. Cuando Luís Fernando está en un lugar de la piscina apartado aprovecha Felicita y se le acerca y comienza a hablar con el sobre los momentos que vivieron juntos, y le ofrece su apoyo y hace que Luís Fernando dude sobre Dileidi. Por otro lado Aureliano aprovecha y aborda a Dileidi y conversa con ella sobre la cara que tiene y además le comenta sobre lo bien que la podría pasar con el si no estuviera empeñada en Luís Fernando. Dileidi duda también de Luís Fernando así como hizo el. La Nena se fue a la playa y reflexiona sobre la forma en que se tiene que sacar de la mente a Doroteo, pero decide y se mete al agua y para su sorpresa cuando sale se encuentra con su Doroteo. Ella comienza a discutir con el y comienza a ahogarse, Doroteo la salva y la saca del agua. Ya fuera del agua Doroteo junto a sus amigos, le da respiración boca a boca a la Nena convirtiéndose en un beso. La Nena abre los ojos y lo ve, y se levanta, Doroteo le dice que ella es de el por haberle salvado la vida y la Nena le da una cacheta y se va de allí. Doroteo se queda muy contento por salvarle la vida a su amada. Pascuita va a que la persona que la depila le inyecte en la cara unas vitaminas, Alegría trata de persuadirla pero ella no escucha consejo. Ya Matilde y Monchito están reunidos para lo del trabajo que tienen que sacar pero los dos no se pueden concentrar en el trabajo por lo enamorado que están y hablan sobre lo que sienten. Gonzalo que se quedo con los morochos, los lleva a donde Rosita para que se los cuide porque el sale con José Tadeo. Después que Felicita hablo con Luís Fernando, Tatiana aprovecha que está solo y se le acerca, le dice lo mucho que el le gusta y le da todo su apoyo. Luís Fernando después de todo eso decide ir a buscar a Dileidi. Yuraima y Yeniluz se dan cuenta y van a avisarle a Dileidi, a su vez cuando Dileidi se entera se esconde para que el no la encuentre. Luís Fernando en su búsqueda se encuentra con Jerson y se da cuenta que el fue quién lo quiso robar pero Luís Fernando lo le para y le cuenta que está buscando a la mujer que ama. Gabito que está con Gladis conversando le reitera su amor, pero Gladis le sigue rechazando. Egle le comenta a la Nena sobre lo aburrida que estaba ella en su matrimonio con Rómulo. Por otro lado Rómulo se dispone a ver su televisión y Betzaida llega a la casa y le recuerda que tienen que salir para los preparativos de la boda, Rómulo trata de salirse del compromiso y no lo logra, pero lo que Rómulo quiere en realidad es quedarse en casa como lo hacía con Egle. Por otro lado Egle se va a pasear por el club y es abordada por Santiago, este comienza a conversar con ella y le insinúa lo bella y divertida que es, y que si estaría dispuesta a salir con un muchacho como el, pero Egle se da cuenta y le pregunta a Santiago si la está invitando a salir.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 12: La Muerte de Reinaldo y Sospechas.
programme.desc: Daniela le dice a su padre que Luis Guillermo es su invitado. Armando no sale de su asombro y Daniela le dice que él está al tanto de los sucedido el día de la boda. Diego piensa en lo que está haciendo al vivir con una mujer que no ama. Marisela sueña despierta en que Diego se ha convertido en su príncipe anhelado. Daniela y Luis tratan de convencer a Armando que su visita es para estrechar los lazos familiares únicamente. Asunta intuye la muerte de Reinaldo. Armando le pregunta a Luis sobre la salud de Reinaldo. Inés recibe la noticia sobre la muerte de Reinaldo en Miami. Inés llama a Luis para darle la noticia. Inés va a casa de Diego a darle la noticia y Michelle le hace un desplante recordándole que es una sirvienta.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Alejandro y Rogelio entran a casa de Elda y se encuentran con Neta y Elda confiesa que se trata de ella pero primero quiere que la lleven a hablar con Ivana. Elda le dice a Ivana la verdad y esta sufre un ataque. Luego Ivana es consolada por Sofía y ahí Sofía se entera de que su hermana apareció pero que es adoptada y es la hoja de la Baronesa. Ambas deciden que van a luchar por su familia. Más tarde le cuentan la noticia a Josué y este no lo puede creer. El detective que contrató Simón le trae fotos de Iris y le dice que según parece lo engaña con Vespasiano entonces Simón se enfurece y le da la oportunidad a Iris de que le diga la verdad y le dice si lo está engañando.

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 25: Socorro y Mercedes Mienten por Amor
programme.desc: Socorro lee el artículo de su madre en donde se dice que en su juventud fue una prostituta. Josefina aparenta tranquilidad y le dice que todo es mentira. Socorro le cree y compra todos los ejemplares de la revista para que nadie vea el artículo. Ramiro enfrenta a su madre, pidiéndole explicaciones sobre la relación que tiene con Salvador. Ella no tiene más remedio que decirle que se están conociendo, pero que las cosas van en serio. Ramiro le dice que en la noche los invita a cenar para hablar más sobre esa relación. Mercedes, que no sabe qué hacer, busca a Salvador y le propone que sean novios de mentiras hasta que su hijo ya supere el tema. Él acepta.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 25: Jesus y Gabriel por Marisela
programme.desc: Cuando Jesús ve que Gabriel está frente a ellos abraza y besa a Marisela aún en contra de su voluntad solo para hacerle ver al hombre que tiene posesión frente a Marisela. Aurora no encuentra la forma para interponerse entre Gabriela y Ricardo e intenta hacerle creer a Isadora que el muchacho no es de fiar, pero Isadora está deslumbrada al ver el carro que el muchacho trae y lo piensa como el hijo de un millonario y lo recibe en medio de sonrisas de alegría. Gabriel furioso intenta demostrar frente a Marisela aplomo y le da órdenes de jefe pero no engaña a nadie todos saben que está celoso.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: San Sebastian: A Food Lover's Town
programme.desc: San Sebastian, Spain: Tony explores the food-crazed Basque culture. Tony's guide, Chef Luis Irizar, takes Tony into the underworld of Basque gastronomic societies. Later, Tony explores the city's tapas bars.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Tony embarks on a pilgrimage to Sydney, Australia so he may indulge in a meal made by one of the world's best chefs - Tetsuya Wakuda.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Napa, CA: Marooned in San Francisco, Tony tastes local shellfish and durian ice cream before embarking on a pilgrimage to experience the genius of Thomas Keller, chef and owner of The French Laundry.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Which style of BBQ reigns supreme - Kansas City, Houston, or North Carolina? Tony journeys to all three cities to taste for himself the secrets behind sauces, wood pits, and slow smokers.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Anthony travels to Tokyo, where he begins in the Tsujiki market and then is introduced to techniques in preparing edomae sushi. He also learns the diets of Sumo wrestlers.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: A spontaneous layover in Bangkok, Thailand leads Tony into the city, where he tries dishes of deep-fried frog skins and pla rah, a fish-paste that has fermented anywhere from three months to a year.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Tony returns to his beloved Hanoi, Vietnam to visit his friend, Linh, for the Vietnamese lunar New Year holiday of Tet. Together they enjoy the holiday and indulge in all the exotic delicacies Vietnamese culture offers.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Rural Japan: Tony decides to look for a more relaxing, traditional Japanese culinary experience in the countryside. Tony travels to an old-style Japanese inn that specializes in kaiseki cuisine, ancient tea ceremony, and local ingredients.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Jumping into a Thai tuk tuk taxi, Tony attempts to soak up Thai culture, and get lost in the cuisine of Chiang Mai, Thailand.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Morocco (Cities): Tony is invited to experience the culinary heart and distinct walled medinas (districts) of the Moroccan city Fes.

programme.title: The Toque 12
programme.desc: Phil eagerly awaits his chance to enjoy, and learn the secrets behind, the divine cuisine found inside DC Restaurant by Darren Chin, a Chef whose inspiration is derived from the high level of satisfaction his guests continually experience.

programme.title: The Toque 12
programme.desc: In the heart of Jakarta lies AMUZ Gourmet Restaurant, an opulent fine-dining experience and a sanctuary of French gastronomy and lifestyle. Chef Gilles Marx introduces Phil to three of AMUZ's renowned signature dishes.

programme.title: The Toque 12
programme.desc: One of the key attributes that makes the Epicurean Market at Marina Bay Sands so special is the concentration of fresh, curated produce from all around the world. Also, Chef David Thompson takes you behind the scenes in his kitchen.

programme.title: Mexico One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless
programme.sub-title: A Pig, a Pit, and a Plan
programme.desc: Cochinita pibil is a slow-cooked, banana leaf-wrapped pork specialty from the Yucatan that Rick finds inspiring, and he takes that inspiration to its pinnacle by digging a brick fire pit in his backyard and slow-roasting an entire pig.

programme.title: Mexico One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless
programme.sub-title: Eat Like a Local in Los Cabos
programme.desc: Ever travel to a tourist mecca and wonder what the locals eat? Join Rick and his friend Hugo to find the best Mexican food in Los Cabos. First stop is the municipal market in San Jose del Cabo, then they enjoy carnitas at Los Michoacanos.

programme.title: Mexico One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless
programme.sub-title: Off the Beaten Path in Playa del Carmen
programme.desc: Join Rick in Playa del Carmen where roadside vendors and stands serve authentic Mexican food. At Le Chique, Chef Jonatan Gomez Luna dazzles Rick with feats of molecular gastronomy. Also, Rick reveals how to execute the perfect taco party.

programme.title: Rituals of the World
programme.desc: From July to September each year, the people of Madagascar organize a traditional rite: the Famadihana, or the "return of the dead." During the ceremony, bodies are removed from their vaults and their descendants happily carry the exhumed body of the deceased on their shoulders, and dance.

programme.title: Rituals of the World
programme.sub-title: Papua New Guinea: The Fire Dance
programme.desc: When a person dies, or to celebrate a harvest or important visit, the Baining tribesmen create masks representing the Spirit of the Forest. A great fire is then lit in the village, and dancers adorning the masks dance around the fire, jumping on the embers to prove they are stronger than the flames.

programme.title: Rituals of the World
programme.sub-title: Ethiopia: A Baptism in the Sky
programme.desc: Journey to the Tigray region of Ethiopia, Africa where Orthodox Christians confront their fears and baptize their children in churches perched 800 meters in the sky in the troglodyte church of Abuna Yemata Guh. The climb is excruciatingly difficult, and extremely dangerous.

programme.title: Secrets of the National Parks
programme.desc: Hawaii Volcanoes and Haleakala National Parks are two of the most extraordinary places on Earth. Here you can witness molten lava bubbling from the earth, catch a spectacular sunrise above the cloud-line, or take a dip into pools of paradise.

programme.title: Green Paradise
programme.desc: Connecting the continents of Asia and Africa, the mountainous country of Oman is beset by sand and water. Overlooking an azure ocean, its emerald rivers add color to the soft red and golden sands. Boasting one of the most diverse natural environments on the Arabian Peninsula, Oman is captured here.

programme.title: Green Paradise
programme.desc: With its wide-open spaces and pristine coastline, the province of KwaZulu-Natal has become one of South Africa's ecotourism havens. Away from the carefree atmosphere of its beaches, become a privileged witness to KwaZulu-Natal's well-preserved flora, fauna, and wildlife, possibly "The Big Five?"

programme.title: Lonely Planet: Best Parks Ever - America's National Parks
programme.desc: If you like your nature a little weird, then this is the show for you. See all the freaks of nature in the best parks ever.

programme.title: Bare Feet with Mickela Mallozzi
programme.desc: In the Bronx, Mickela meets with the largest Garifuna community in the United States, a people of Afro-Caribbean culture with Central American influences whose dances and music have miraculously survived generations of incredible odds.

programme.title: Bare Feet with Mickela Mallozzi
programme.desc: From Lincoln Center to Broadway, NYC's dance, theatrical, and musical stages are open for business and ready to electrify audiences. Join Mickela and meet the people responsible for the future of New York City's performing arts.

programme.title: Laura McKenzie's Traveler
programme.desc: Romania is home to medieval villages and fairy-tale castles. Its history embellished with romantic legends and religious conquests makes it a truly unique area. Experience Carpathian Mountain country and explore the folklore behind Transylvania.

programme.title: Laura McKenzie's Traveler
programme.desc: Laura McKenzie takes you on an unforgettable tour of Thailand, Vietnam, Cambodia, and Singapore, including a visit to the incredible Ayutthaya Kingdom.

programme.title: Laura McKenzie's Traveler
programme.desc: Edinburgh Castle stands boldly atop Castle Rock. Visit St. Margaret's Chapel, the oldest building in Edinburgh, and become acquainted with the legend of Greyfriars Bobby. The Royal Mile and the Grassmarket will keep you busy and fed and tour the waters in luxury aboard the HMY Britannia.

programme.title: Porthole Cruise and Travel Show
programme.desc: Cruising Alaska's pristine glacial waters is an experience unlike any other, and UnCruise Adventures will transport you through this awe-inspiring region in style. Join Bill as he soaks in the pure splendor of Alaska's angelic wilderness.

programme.title: Jeremy Pang's Asian Kitchen
programme.desc: Jeremy's iconic first dish is Crispy Belly Pork. In the classroom Joe Swash creates Veggie Singapore Noodles. Jeremy then makes Tea Smoked Duck and Pancakes, followed by a Macanese Egg Tart, the perfect accompaniment for a cup of tea.

programme.title: Mexico One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: Rick and Lanie begin a romantic adventure on the main square in Merida where they fall under the charms of Marquesitas. In the Santa Ana Market, they savor tortas, panuchos, and impossible cake. Inspired, they head home to make Salbutes.

programme.title: Mexico One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: To beat the heat, Rick leaves the kitchen for a cookout a la Mexicana, inspired by one of his world-favorite meat eateries: El Canelo, near Guadalajara. Rick also provides a quick lesson in setting up a home grill for wood-fired cooking.

programme.title: Ottolenghi's Mediterranean Island Feast
programme.desc: On the dreamy island of Mallorca, Yotam leaves the busy beaches behind and heads inland to search for authentic local cuisine and ingredients that inspire him to create a few culinary masterpieces of his own in the kitchen.

programme.title: Mythical Roads
programme.sub-title: In the Footsteps of James Cook
programme.desc: The Pacific was the last maritime space explored by Europeans. In the 18th century, it was James Cook who, over three expeditions, went exhaustively over the zone, mapped it, and discovered many islands. The British explorer has always been associated with this part of the world.

programme.title: Mythical Roads
programme.desc: The Volga River, also called "matuschka," welcomes world travelers on giant boats. Take a journey of 4,000 kilometers towards the Caspian Sea, from Moscow to Astrakhan, through Laroslav, Nijini Novgorod, Kazan, Samara, and Saratov.

programme.title: Lonely Planet: Best Parks Ever - America's National Parks

programme.title: Bare Feet with Mickela Mallozzi

programme.desc: Avalanche danger is very high in the Rogers Pass area of the Trans Canada Highway in British Columbia. Host of Angry Planet George Kourounis travels with a variety of experts to bring down huge avalanches in the Rocky Mountains. Ski Patrollers throw hand charges to clear the slopes, the British Columbia Department of Highways uses helicopter bombing and mountaintop mortars to keep the roads safe, and the Canadian Armed Forces fire 105mm howitzers at the mountains to bring down the dangerous snow. programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Barney's excited to find out that Rusty's family is adopting a new baby sister from China; however, Rusty's not sure if he's going to be a good brother, and he doesn't know much about China. Barney shows Rusty and the others some info China on the computer and BJ and Baby Bop talk about siblings. Through Barney's Travel Book, Barney takes Rusty, BJ and Baby Bop on an adventure to China where he can learn more about his new sister's heritage. When they get there, the people are celebrating Chinese New Year. From lion dances and talented performers to tasty treats, making lanterns and puppet shows, the celebration never runs out of fun. By the time he returns to the park, Rusty excitedly meets his new baby sister, named Mei Ling, and realizes he will be the best big brother ever.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Ben is late to the park and is disappointed to realize he missed his chance at riding a real pony. Ben and Barney return to the park just in time for him to ride the pony after all! Ben is thrilled to ride a horse and learned an important lesson about patience and waiting.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Emma is stuck with a school project and can't play soccer with Joshua. Having to interview her parents and get info about an interesting ancestor, she is frustrated with the assignment. Barney helps her discover that her ancestors were from Venice, Italy. Using his Travel Book, Barney takes Joshua, Emma, and Riff to Venice, Italy. He gives his friends a gondola ride as well as telling them about famous explorer Marco Polo. Barney's friend, Anna Maria tells Emma that she knew her great grandfather and takes her to his shop, where they try on masks and make some of their own. Emma learns that if she makes the mask in parts, she'll get it done. Barney reminds her of this lesson, so she will do the same for her school project.

programme.title: Barney and Friends

programme.title: Barney and Friends

programme.title: Barney and Friends

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.sub-title: A Bird of a Different Feather

Meanwhile, Ben and Rusty search for the bird, with a few close calls (a feather and what ended up being a coconut). In Nebraska, firearms instructor Thea Van Syoc has used the disciplines of competitive pistol shooting and training to help shape her life. Finally we’ll take a look into the National African American Gun Association and learn how one day at the range for Phillip Smith created the fastest growing firearm organization in the United States.

programme.title: Winchester Life

We’ll also head to Missouri and Texas to chase whitetails with Chris Keefer and Paul Sawyer.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: We set out to tell the tale of Marion - and his legendary Mack’s Prairie Wings, smack dab in the middle of the world famous Stuttgart, Arkansas - the land of ducks and rice. Get an inside look at a man that many consider to be larger than life, from those that knew him best, like his cousin and fellow hell raiser, Bud McCollum. We’ll even hear a story or two from Milton Stovesand, an 81 year old former waterfowl guide and Mack’s employee who actually guided John Olin a time or two, and ran the timber holes with Marion. It’s timber holes and tall tales. It’s cups of coffee and cupped up wings. It’s partners in business, and partners in potholes and it’s pure Arkansas...just like Marion.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Melissa Bachman has made her name over the last two decades as one of the most dedicated hunters and producers in the outdoor industry. In this episode we’ll tag along with Melissa while she chases big game around the world with her Winchester in hand. First we’ll head to Colorado as Melissa spot and stalks giant mule deer, then we’ll head across the pond to New Zealand to chase mountain ibex and tar, then head back to the states for Montana whitetail at ground level.

programme.title: Dirt
programme.sub-title: DIRT - "Louisiana's Wild Food & Award-Winning Cuisine | Hog Hunting, Swamp Fishing & MORE"
programme.desc: In Episode 2: New Orleans, Josh links up with Mason Hereford (owner of award-winning sandwich shop Turkey and the Wolf) and then hits the road for some epic hog hunting, swamp fishing, crawfish and oyster harvesting, and exploring Louisiana’s only water buffalo dairy farm. It all culminates in one incredible feast featuring unique regional dishes prepared by Mason with the help of some local friends.

programme.title: Dirt
programme.sub-title: DIRT - "Can You Surf & Eat Like a Local in Minnesota? Wild Foraging & Delicious Local Eats"
programme.desc: In Episode 3, Josh starts off in the Twin Cities where he meets up with Yia Vang, an award-winning Hmong chef and restaurant owner, bringing his family’s traditions and flavors to the American Midwest. As Josh heads up north to Duluth and the boundary waters, he’ll meet plenty of farmers and foragers—harvesting mushrooms, wild rice, and catching a few fish (and waves) along the way. It all wraps up with an epic feast hosted by Yia back in the cities.

programme.title: Dirt
programme.sub-title: DIRT - "Exploring New York City's Hidden Culinary Gems: Cooking Goat Brains, Lobster & MORE"
programme.desc: New. York. City. That’s where our host Josh Rosen kicks off his journey in Episode 4—and where he lived for 16 years and started up the surf-centric apparel brand, Saturdays NYC. Back in his old stomping grounds, Josh first meets up with the award-winning chef and Mumbai native, Chintan Pandya, currently blowing up the New York food scene with his unapologetic and authentic Indian cuisine (pro tip: try the goat brains). Next, Josh travels through the boroughs, heads upstate, and along the coast to source local ingredients—from sake brewers and pig farmers to catching fresh lobster just 100 miles from Wall Street. As always the adventure will end with a feast, right back in Chintan’s kitchen.

programme.title: Dirt
programme.sub-title: DIRT - "Alaskan Fishing, Foraging, & Mountainside Cooking with Local Legends"
programme.desc: Hop in the float plane—a new episode of DIRT just dropped. The DIRT crew made their way to Alaska, “the land of earth, sea, and sky.” All feast, no sleep is the name of the game as Josh makes the most of Alaska’s abundant and legendary daylight alongside local guides, fishermen, and even a couple grizzlies. There’ll be plenty of time to hibernate in winter. But for now—join us—there are halibut to filet, rainforest ’shrooms to forage, and mountainside meals to cook up.

programme.title: Mission to the Moon
programme.desc: In the international race to the moon, the Norwegian mission is led by brilliant inventor Reodor from the village of Flaklypa. With Louis the Magpie as the brave astronaut, what could possibly go wrong? Quite a bit, actually – on the daring mission, secret passengers are discovered, hidden agendas are revealed, and nothing seems to work out the way it was planned. Louis and his friend Luca the Hedgehog are in for some surprises on their trip to the moon. The third film in the stop-motion trilogy featuring the beloved characters from the Flaklypa universe.

programme.title: Spy Cat
programme.desc: Four crazy anti-heroes, one pawsome adventure. Join special-agent Marnie and her friends as they team up and fight crime. Spoiled and innocent, chubby house cat Marnie lives a comfortable and pampered life in the Sunshine household. She has never ventured outside the family home and only knows about the real world through her favourite detective, crime TV-shows.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy Lupin manages to convince the pack elders to let him sit Howlington Academy’s entrance test. Freddy must use all his poodle wits- and his best friend Batty’s help!- to win a place at the historically wolf-only academy.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s the first day of school, and Freddy immediately comes into conflict with bully Ivan, who blackmails him into stealing the sacred moonstone! But when Batty is exposed to the moonstone, she’s turned into a human girl!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy attempts to teach Batty how to be human, while searching for a cure for her new form. A class assignment to capture the mysterious ‘Golden Horn’ and prove who the ‘alpha’ wolf is goes awry when a wilderwolf attacks!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy becomes convinced that there’s a wilderwolf at Howlington, and launches a daring investigation to prove that it’s the school accountant, Mr Sminch. Howlington gets a new teacher, the super cool and charming Ric Rawls.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids are struck down by a flea infestation, and Freddy and Batty are tasked with tracking down the mysterious Doog, keeper of the Fleaminator, the most powerful flea treatment known to dog, before they’re all expelled!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids head out on their first excursion to Night Patrol HQ. Freddy gets pulled into Scarlet’s world as she gets closer to the truth about werewolves and the two bond when they get stuck in the forest while tracking a wolf.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s Howloween, and Howlington is on lockdown. But when the students stage a play that goes wrong and the lockdown is disrupted, it will be up to the kids to save the grown-ups from themselves - including Principal Pincus!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy and Ivan have failed their runes exam and have to do it over - or they won’t be allowed to attend the Doom Wolves concert. But their study session ends up putting themselves, and the Doom Wolves, in grave danger!

programme.title: Back to the Sea
programme.desc: When little fish Kevin is swept up in a net and taken from his home in the vast oceans to the small glass fish tank of a restaurant, he must find a way to escape and make his way back home.

programme.title: Racetime
programme.desc: Frankie and Sophie challenge newcomers Zac and Charlie to an epic sled race.

programme.title: Son of Bigfoot
programme.desc: A teenage boy journeys to find his missing father only to discover that he's actually Bigfoot.

programme.title: Ozzy
programme.desc: The lovable Ozzy’s pampered life is thrown into turmoil after his family drops him at Blue Creek before their vacation. Ozzy quickly learns that Blue Creek is a dog prison and he’ll need to rely on some new friends to help him break out and get back home.

programme.title: Stardog & Turbocat
programme.desc: A loyal dog and a vigilante cat embark on a space age voyage to find their way home.

programme.title: Rally Road Racers
programme.desc: A rookie race-car driver gets the opportunity to compete against the reigning champion. With help from a former driver, he must overcome treacherous terrain, rival racers and unexpected obstacles to prove he has what it takes.

programme.title: Cats
programme.desc: A cat named Blanket lives in the city with his son, Cape. One day, Cape decides to leave home and embarks on an adventure to find the legendary cat's paradise. To find his son, Blanket must overcome his fear and reconcile with his past.

programme.title: Tall Tales
programme.desc: When his beloved Queen bee Marguerite is kidnapped, vagabond cricket Apollo who has been framed for the crime, teams up with the other bugs to save the Queen and the entire kingdom.

programme.title: Luis and the Aliens
programme.desc: A boy at risk of being sent to boarding school by his Dad - and three aliens stranded due to watching too much TV - must help each other out.

programme.title: Boonie Bears : The Big Shrink
programme.desc: After purchasing a mysterious shrink ray machine, Vick accidentally shrinks Briar, Bramble, and himself. The tiny team must put aside their differences and embark on one big journey to restore their size and their friendship.

Louis and his friend Luca the Hedgehog are in for some surprises on their trip to the moon. The third film in the stop-motion trilogy featuring the beloved characters from the Flaklypa universe.

programme.title: Blitzed: The 80s Blitz Kids Story
programme.desc: Boy George was the coat check girl (admittedly stealing money from the purses) .... Bowie, synth beats, and a new freedom of sexual identity were in the air. The Blitz Club spell was cast and a hotbed of talent emerged: Ultravox, Spandau Ballet, Culture Club, Sade, and practically everyone else you've ever heard from the era.

programme.title: MOD SUN Interview: Walk With Me | SPIN Cover Story
programme.desc: No doubt MOD’s lived many lives since Happy To Be Here was first published in 2015, stating that he feels fortunate to have accomplished so much of what he’d set out to do. His main goal is to keep evolving.

programme.title: Gil Scott-Heron - Black Wax
programme.desc: BLACK WAX is a musical-political entertainment film produced and directed by Robert Mugge. It centers on the late African American poet-singer-songwriter Gil Scott-Heron - the man Melody Maker called the most dangerous musician alive and many dubbed the forefather of rap music - and his Midnight Band.

programme.title: SPIN COVER STORY yungblud: "walk with me"
programme.desc: If Yungblud led a cult, many would join - even those who fancy themselves hard to persuade. He has an orbit, an aura, an affability that is borderline intoxicating. You can experience it for yourself during our walk with Yungblud through the Sunset Strip, from the Viper Room to the Rainbow Bar and Grill – watch Yungblud share some incredible stories and a Dr Pepper

programme.title: Looking for Johnny: The Legend of Johnny Thunders
programme.desc: Johnny Thunders was the legendary hard-living rock n roll guitarist who inspired glam-metal, punk and the music scene in general. Looking For Johnny is a 90-minute film that documents Thunders career from his beginnings to his tragic death in 1991. The film examines his career as a member of the New York Dolls, the punk scene with The Heartbreakers in New York City and London and much more.

programme.title: LoudQUIETloud: A Film About the Pixies
programme.desc: loudQUIETloud follows the rehearsals and the warm-up shows for the full-fledged, sold-out Pixies reunion tour. It also catalogs, in the cinema-verite style of the Rolling Stones' Gimme Shelter, the less glamorous side of the touring band lifestyle, getting as close to this enigmatic act as anyone is ever likely to get. The Pixies have a once-in-a-lifetime chance at rock n roll redemption.

programme.title: Johnny Thunders - Madrid Memory
programme.desc: A long lost live concert performance from The Heartbreakers explosive 1984 reunion world tour that included fellow Dolls Sylvain Sylvain & Jerry Nolan plus Billy Rath! Filmed for TV broadcast at La Edad De Oro in Madrid, Spain, this concert captures powerful performances of songs from throughout Thunders's amazing career including Personality Crisis, Too Much Junkie Business, Born Too Lose

programme.title: MOD SUN Interview: Walk With Me | SPIN Cover Story
programme.desc: No doubt MOD’s lived many lives since Happy To Be Here was first published in 2015, stating that he feels fortunate to have accomplished so much of what he’d set out to do. His main goal is to keep evolving.

programme.title: Nightclubbing: The Birth of Punk Rock in NYC
programme.desc: Nightclubbing is the first ever documentary about the renowned New York City nightclub Max's Kansas City (1965-1981) which had an indelible impact on the world of music, fashion, art, culture and the creation of the New York City Punk Rock scene

programme.title: SPIN Presents: Trailers From Hell
programme.desc: A TFH collection of some of Hollywoods most memorable "Movies That Rock!"

programme.title: Fuzztones - Live At Rockpalast
programme.desc: Great garage rock revival spectacle with The Fuzztones all-time favorites recorded live at German's Rockpalast: Cheeky, snotty, dirty, full of energy.

programme.title: String Theory: Guitar Obsessed
programme.desc: String Theory: Guitar Obsessed delivers a humorous but reverent look at why we love the guitar. Among the 24 distinguished people in the film: Execs from 5 major manufactures, 4 well known internet instructors and retail guitar store owners in the USA and the UK...plus distinguished professors and even the former Deputy Director of the FBI. If you play guitar, you will want to see this movie.

programme.sub-title: Problemas con el Tren de Aterrizaje
programme.desc: Frustrada por su falta de vuelo y atrapada en una rutina como conductora de mensajería.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cuando una avería en el ferry provoca una escasez de gasolina en Yellowknife.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Duane consigue un contrato enorme para el Electra y ejerce una enorme presión sobre el mecánico Adam.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Las chispas vuelan cuando Joe descubre que Gord ha aceptado un trabajo con una aerolínea rival.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Tratando de dejar su huella en Buffalo, Duane consigue dos contratos más de Electra.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: La decisión de Duane de dejar al equipo de Electra sin supervisión mientras pasa tiempo en casa pone en peligro.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: El mecánico Jimmy es enviado a un campamento minero del norte para crear una pista de aterrizaje de hielo en un lago remoto.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Problemas de motor en el C-46 durante la carrera en valle obligan a Devan a apagar un motor.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cuando Yellowknife y la comunidad de aviación del norte se ven sacudidos por tres accidentes en el espacio de un mes...

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Joe recibe una visita negativa de Transport Canada cuando los inspectores amenazan con cerrar la aerolínea.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Abrumado por la responsabilidad de entrenar a un nuevo rampie y luchando por salir de la caseta del perro de Joe.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Después de tomar el mando de un puente aéreo intenso y lidiar con la carga de Electra más fea que jamás haya visto.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: A solo unos meses de jubilarse, el capitán de Electra, Ray Weber, dirige a su tripulación en una misión de varios viajes.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cuando los compradores surcoreanos vienen a Buffalo para ver un bombardero de agua.
